hero.paragraph: HydroLedger iha inyubako z'abaturage ubumenyi bw'igihe nyacyo bw'ikoreshwa ry'amazi, kwishyura bitunganye bishingiye ku mikoreshereze, n'amatarazinga yo kumenya aho imiyoboro y'amazi yaba yacikiyemo — byose kuri mudasobwa imwe.

trustBar.label: Icyizere cy'amatsinda acunga inyubako nyinshi zigezweho

features.paragraph: Sezerera uburyo bwo kwishyura amafaranga amwe n'amwe. HydroLedger iteza imbere ubutabera mu kwishyura binyuze mu gupima neza no gukora ibintu mu buryo bwikora.

items.title: Gupima Amazi mu gihe nyacyo
items.text: Pima amazi akoreshwa neza, buri munota kuri buri nzu aho kwishingikiriza ku mibare itari yo y'ikigereranyo.

items.title: Kwishyura Amarisiti byikora
items.text: Kwandika inyemezabwishyu zihabwa abaturage zikurikije uko bakoresheje. Gukemura ibibazo byo kwishyura ako kanya.

items.title: Kumenya aho amazi yacikiyemo hakiri kare
items.text: Amarazinga yikora atabaza igihe imiyoboro idakora neza, bigafasha guhagarika ibyangirika mu gihe gito, atari mu mezi.

items.title: Gukwirakwiza Ibiguzi mu buryo buboneye
items.text: Kurikirana ikoreshwa ry'ahantu rusange maze ubebe ibiguzi mu buryo bugaragara kugira ngo abaturage bagire icyizere.

howItWorks.heading: Gushyiraho byihuse, Gukora bitagusabye imbaraga
howItWorks.paragraph: Tangira vuba. Iyo ibikoresho byamaze kwihuza, urubuga rukora imibare igoranye, rugohereza inyemezabwishyu, n'amarazinga y'aho amazi yacikiyemo.

steps.title: Huza Amametero Agezweho
steps.text: Abatekinisiye bacu bashyira amametero y'amazi ku miyoboro ya buri nzu mu minota itarenze 15.

steps.title: Gukurikirana Igihe Nyacyo
steps.text: Amakuru yoherezwa kuri HydroLedger cloud, yandika imibare nyayo y'ikoreshwa n'ibindi bitari bisanzwe.

steps.title: Kwishyura mu buryo bwikora
steps.text: Mu mpera z'ukwezi, sisitemu ihuriza hamwe ibyo abantu bose bakoze n'ibyo buri nzu yakoresheje mu nyemezabwishyu zikubiyeho byose.

portalPreview.paragraph: Ubusobanuro bwubaka ubumwe. Abaturage bishimira imbuga zoroshye zerekana ikoreshwa ryabo, ibiguzi biteganyijwe, n'amarazinga y'aho amazi yacikiyemo.
portalPreview.tipText: Imiyoboro yo mu gikoni cyawe isa n'aho irimo amazi adahagarara mu gitondo. Kugenzura imiyoboro bishobora kuzigama litiro 10 buri cyumweru.

audienceSplit.residentHeading: Ibiguzi by'amazi biboneye bishingiye ku ikoreshwa
audienceSplit.residentParagraph: Reka kwishyura ibyo utakoze. Wishyura gusa ayo wakoresheje, bishingiye ku makuru yo mu gihe nyacyo.
residentBullets: Amakuru y'amapimo neza buri kwezi n'ibisobanuro by'ibiguzi.
Amarazinga kuri SMS na telefone niba hari utuzi twacitse muri ibikoresho byawe.
Sisitemu yoroshye yo kwishyura hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga n'inyemezabwishyu zikubiyeho.
audienceSplit.adminParagraph: Hindura uko ucunga amazu uva mu gukoresha imbaraga nyinshi ujya mu micungire yoroshye n'inyungu zihuse.
adminBullets: Gukwirakwiza ibiguzi by'amazi bitagusabye gukora byinshi.
Amarazinga y'igihe nyacyo kugira ngo wirinde ibyangirika bikomeye.
Raporo yuzuye ku mibare y'amazi akoreshejwe muri rusange ugereranyije n'ayo buri nzu yakoresheje.

pricing.heading: Ibiguzi by'imikorere bitanga inyungu ndende
pricing.paragraph: Hitamo gahunda ihuye n'imiterere y'inyubako yawe. HydroLedger akenshi yishyura ibiguzi byayo mu kwezi kwa mbere binyuze mu kugabanya ibyangirika.

tiers.name: Intangiriro
tiers.desc: Byiza ku muryango muto w'abaturage ukeneye gupima amazi mu buryo bw'ibanze.

tiers.name: Umwuga
tiers.desc: Gahunda yacu y'ibanze ku nyubako zikomeye zishaka kwishyura byikora.

tiers.name: Ikigo
tiers.desc: Ku mishinga migari ikeneye ibisubizo byihariye n'imiterere y'ishyurwa.

quotes.text: HydroLedger yahinduye imikoreshereze y'amafaranga yacu. Twabonye aho imiyoboro y'amazi yari yacikiye mu buryo butagaragaraga bituma duziga amafaranga menshi mu mezi atatu ya mbere.
Icyizere cy'abaturage cyazamutse. Kwishyura bishingiye ku mazi yakoreshejwe aho kwishingikiriza ku mibare rusange byakemuye ibibazo byinshi twari dufite.

items.q: Ese amametero agezweho asaba gufunga amazi yose?
items.a: Oya. Amametero yacu ashyirwa hejuru y'imiyoboro isanzwe mu minota mike idasabye gufunga amazi y'abandi.

items.q: Ese ibiguzi by'amazi rusange bicarwa bite?
items.a: Amazi akoreshejwe ahantu rusange akurwa mu mibare nyamukuru mbere. Amatsinda y'abacunga inyubako agabanya ayo mafaranga mu buryo buboneye.

items.q: HydroLedger ibona ite aho amazi acikiyemo vuba?
items.a: Sisitemu yacu igenzura imikoreshereze y'amazi. Niba amazi akomeje gutemba mu minota 10, ikohereza ubutumwa bwo kumenyesha vuba.

items.q: Ese HydroLedger yita ku banga ry'abaturage?
items.a: Yego. HydroLedger yita ku banga ry'abaturage ikoresheje uburyo bwo guhisha amakuru. Amakuru akoreshwa gusa mu gukurikirana ikoreshwa ry'amazi.

cta.heading: Tangira kugenzura amazi yawe uyu munsi
cta.paragraph: Zamura ikoreshwa ry'amazi, koroshya kwishyura, n'ukurinda inyubako zawe. Reka tugufashe kubara inyungu zawe.

footer.tagline: Gucunga amazi mu buryo bugezweho n'uburyo bwo kuyapima. Rinda sisitemu, kiranura inyemezabwishyu, ronga amazi.
